threshold.value: Party A: infinity (subject to conditions); Party B: not specified (0 by default)
threshold.evidence_quote:
“Threshold”
                  means, with respect to Party A, infinity, provided that if a Ratings
                  Event
                  or Collateralization Event has occurred and is continuing, the
                  Threshold
                  with respect to Party A shall be zero

minimum_transfer_amount.value: $100,000 (or $50,000 if aggregate Principal Balance of Certificates rated by S&P ceases to be more than $50,000,000)
minimum_transfer_amount.evidence_quote:
“Minimum
                  Transfer Amount” means,
                  with respect to a party, $100,000; provided, however, that if the
                  aggregate Principal Balance of the Certificates rated by S&P ceases to
                  be more than $50,000,000, then the Minimum Transfer Amount shall
                  mean
                  $50,000.

rounding.value: Delivery Amount rounded up to nearest $1,000; Return Amount rounded down to nearest $1,000
rounding.evidence_quote:
The
                  Delivery Amount will be rounded up to the nearest integral multiple
                  of
                  $1,000 and the Return Amount will be rounded down to the nearest
                  integral
                  multiple of $1,000.
